scorecard.rationale: In a five-person Parkinson and Lewy body dementia aroma series, two improved on swallowing tests, one was unchanged and two dropped out. Other aroma series gave mixed results. Topical piperine in burning-mouth syndrome reported binary dysphagia with different baseline and follow-up denominators. Swallowing severity after eating cracked pepper remains open. The full Rofes original distinguishes a favorable acute instrumental high-concentration PAS comparison (3.25 to 1.85, p=.003) from an inconclusive low-concentration comparison (2.10 to 1.95, p=.521). All four neurodegenerative participants were in the lower group and diagnosis-specific results were not supplied. The study fixes the unfortified nectar first for everyone. The edible-film experiment measures detection and adaptation, without linking cracked pepper particle texture, local dose or timing to airway protection. Alongside mixed aroma series, the different preparations and absent comparable solid-food result leave the culinary sign open.
